purpose: Document first-party local-government discovery and bounded anonymous cadastral/map-service review for Corrientes, Argentina.
assessment: The official Municipalidad de la Ciudad de Corrientes IDEMCC is a locally scoped geospatial portal. Its official description says it provides municipal cadastral base information and 144 geographic layers; the current indexed viewer lists Parcelario Catastral and Parcelas PH. The municipal procedure page directs users to that viewer for parcel location. No safe anonymous feature response, native parcel ID, geometry, or CRS was obtained from this environment.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is justified by first-party municipal evidence of a local cadastral map/procedure: the official municipal page names the Dirección General de Catastro and directs users to the municipal Parcelario Catastral viewer. This does not establish downloadable open geometry or citywide completeness.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official IDEMCC description identifies the Municipalidad de la Ciudad de Corrientes, its municipal geoservice mission, and cadastral base information; it states the infrastructure contains 144 geographic layers and 9 raster layers.
Official municipal viewer indexed the Informacion catastral group, including Parcelario Catastral, Parcelas PH, and Manzanas.

Official IDEMCC geoservices page documents municipal WMS/WFS service types. The page was not safely retrievable over HTTPS from this environment; indexed first-party content was used only for route discovery, and no credentials were used.
Official municipal procedure names the Dirección General de Catastro and directs users to Información Geográfica / Información Catastral / Parcelario Catastral for parcel location.
Official provincial Registro de la Propiedad Inmueble establishes the property-registry context, distinct from the municipal cadastral map; no owner/title data was requested or retained.
